<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv
import io

# Read input
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Define indicator columns (all except city_id, city_name, year)
meta_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]

# Compute missingness per indicator
total_rows = len(df)
missingness = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = int(df[col].isna().sum())
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows
    kept = 'True' if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 'False'
    missingness.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Write missingness report
report_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness)
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

# Determine kept indicators
kept_cols = [row['indicator'] for row in missingness if row['kept'] == 'True']

# Write selected matrix
selected_df = df[meta_cols + kept_cols].copy()
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
</solution_file>

import pandas as pd
import csv
import io

# Read input
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Define indicator columns (all except city_id, city_name, year)
meta_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]

# Compute missingness per indicator
total_rows = len(df)
missingness = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = int(df[col].isna().sum())
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows
    kept = 'True' if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 'False'
    missingness.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Write missingness report
report_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness)
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

# Determine kept indicators
kept_cols = [row['indicator'] for row in missingness if row['kept'] == 'True']

# Write selected matrix
selected_df = df[meta_cols + kept_cols].copy()
